module.purpose: Coordinates creation of a recurring booking series by preparing shared recurrence metadata, invoking the standard booking handler for each slot, preserving round-robin assignment state, and collecting created booking responses.
module.summary: This module is an asynchronous orchestration wrapper around the normal booking creation flow. It maps recurring slot dates, carries platform and email settings into each request, performs an initial round-robin booking to establish assigned users, then processes remaining slots sequentially while propagating third-party recurrence identifiers and assignment metadata.
module.businessContext: Supports recurring appointment scheduling across platform integrations and calendar-backed bookings. Failure can create incomplete series, lose assignment consistency, or leave external recurring-event state unsynchronized.
functions: handleNewRecurringBooking (~L25-129): Creates recurring bookings sequentially with shared scheduling and platform metadata.

network: Delegates each slot to the booking creation handler, which may create external booking and calendar records.
